dataset_family: Japanese community cohorts pooled: Nobeoka city public-health telephone survey (n=1111, no long-term-care certification) + Kobe adult day-care centres (n=350, three facilities); National Cerebral and Cardiovascular Centre with Canary Speech; N=1461
method_family: Wav2Vec2 512-dim acoustic embeddings of 3-min free speech, fully connected DNN (voice-only and voice+age/sex/education), XGBoost demographic reference models; held-out test set (Kobe facility split, Nobeoka random 7:3)
what_it_shows: Voice recorded by telephone (Nobeoka) or in person (Kobe) during an interviewer-prompted 3-min free talk. On a held-out test set of 482, the voice-only DNN reaches AUC 0.81 and accuracy 0.79. Adding age and sex (or age, sex and education) gives AUC 0.88-0.89 but accuracy only 0.81. The source-specific test AUCs are 0.79-0.80, and the authors say the higher pooled AUC may reflect class separability between the two sources (21% vs 81% impaired). The target is an MCI Screen Memory Performance Index below 49.8, a memory-test proxy, not a clinical MCI diagnosis. There is no head-to-head against a specialist instrument.
why: Kiyoshige et al. 2025, Lancet Regional Health - Western Pacific 59:101598. The PDF title, authors and DOI match the block (the block is headed by the filename PMID_40673165_main.pdf, but its Title/Authors/DOI fields match) and the map entry. Read in full to the references. TABLE A1 ('consumer-grade, self-administered ... high standalone accuracy ~88-94%'): NO. (1) Not self-administered: participants spoke 'under minimal interviewer intervention', by telephone call or in person (p.3-4). (2) Accuracy is 0.72-0.81 for every model in Table 2 (p.7); the voice-only model is 0.79. The in-range figures (0.88-0.89) are AUCs, not accuracies, and they need age/sex/education added. (3) The label is a memory-test cut-off. NARROWED WORDING ('low-cost behavioural data captured without specialist hardware reported best-case standalone accuracies of about 88-94% in small internally validated samples'): NO. The study does use low-cost capture (telephone), is standalone and has no head-to-head, but its core quantity misses the band. Best-case accuracy is 0.81; voice-only AUC is 0.81; per-source AUCs are 0.79-0.80 (p.10). The sample is large with a held-out test set, not small and cross-validated. It would support a different statement (about 80% accuracy and AUC 0.8-0.9 from telephone voice in a large held-out sample), not the ~88-94% band. INDEPENDENCE: a Japanese sample with no overlap with I-CONECT (P-76/P-77) or the Shanghai/Henan Memory Guard sample (P-101). No shared authors with the supporters or the other candidates. REGISTRY DEFECTS: Best_Metric 'AUC 0.8' records the age-sex reference model, not the best model (0.89, or 0.81 voice-only); Dataset 'not reported', although the PDF names the Nobeoka and Kobe datasets.
